title: Tailoring an iron-based metal–organic framework for a Zn-ORR/CER battery
content:

A tailored bifunctional cathode catalyst, Fe-Tp-10% G, was utilized for the conversion of HCl to industrially valuable Cl2 while storing energy in a Zn-ORR/CER battery.
